Name: I Hate The Antichrist
Author: qasdxzaq
Description:
Adds corn syrup, high fructose corn syrup, and corn flour. Also a UN peacekeeper helmet.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842][color=#f4cccc].[/color][/url]

Corn flour is made by milling corn.

Corn syrup is made by putting corn flour into a preserves jar.

High fructose corn syrup is made by putting 2 corn syrup in a keg.

The peacekeeper helmet is sold by hat mouse or tailored with either corn syrup.

Both corn syrups are considered "Sugar (Any)" when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cornucopia - Cooking Recipes[/url] in flexible mode.

Has compatibility handlers for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28521]Sweet Valley[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16223]Will's Taffy Mod[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]WAG[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36232]Corn Expanded[/url].
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480[/url] for allowing me to use the corn flour assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], with the corn flour sprite by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru]MizuJakkaru[/url].
